item.title: Food Line Briefing — June 8, 2026
item.description: NEPM reported rising food-assistance demand in Western Massachusetts, including strain affecting SNAP households. another aspect of that Big Beautiful Bill is shifting the cost of SNAP onto states, if they can't keep their error rate below 6%. Massachusetts is hovering around 14%. And an under-resourced DTA is more likely to make mistakes. When benefits are delayed or paused, food pantries may see higher demand from households that rely on SNAP.
